row.title: TENANT-STANDARD-1: one standard, one scaffold and one check for every tenant repository
row.body: A tenant repository's contents are data in doctrine/tenant-standard.json. One scaffold (scaffold/tenant, foundation/tenantstd.py, called by tenantrepos prepare) writes every standard file from one identity object, saved as ultrastable.json. One check reads it: tenantstd in checks, in tenant-repos.yml against each repository's main, and vendored into each tenant's ci.yml. Verified by tests/foundation/test_tenantstd.py, which scaffolds a tenant and runs its Worker tests.
